name: feature.cdp.nodes
description: CDP feature node pack — the identity-resolution read over ctx.features.cdp (ADR CDP-A): a golden-record lookup by identifier so a workflow can branch on a resolved contact. Tenant-guarded; internal columns projected out. role:action (recorded) so replay/fork read the recorded result.
author: OpenWOP App

nodes.label: CDP: Resolve Identity
nodes.description: Resolves an identifier to the tenant golden record over ctx.features.cdp.resolveIdentity. Inputs: { type, value }. Output: { resolved: { contact, identifiers, resolvedBy } | null, masked }. PII values are MASKED (CLNP-3): the result is recorded into the run event log, so no pii-read grant applies; contactId stays clear for branching. Tenant-guarded.
